_about: Proposed spelling map for A1. Applied after lowercase + v->u + j->i. Keys and values are in u/i spelling. Edit freely: delete a line to reject it, move a line from _rejected to map to accept it. Once approved this becomes data/variant_map.json.

_conventions.prefixes: assimilated forms (imm-, ill-, irr-, aff-, all-, ass-, coll-, succ-, summ-), except adsum (assum is a different word, 'roast')
_conventions.ex+s: exs- kept (exsilium, exstinguo, exsequor), matching LatinCy's lookup (exsanguis)
_conventions.medieval spellings in Ecerinis: th/ch/y/e-for-ae forms mapped to the classical spelling Seneca's edition uses (thorus, aethnaeus, arcthoo, stix, thus, seta, sulphureus, executor, negligens)

_optional_syncope._note: Syncopated poetic forms. Same word, but some editors treat them as distinct lemmas. Not in the map unless you move them up.

_rejected._note: Found by the scan but these are different words.
_rejected.comito/committo: comito is fixed separately (comito -> comitor in lemma_fixes_proposed.csv)
_rejected.loeo/leo: loeo is a garbled form (Aga 'loeas'), not a spelling of leo
_rejected.coaetus/coetus: coaetos (Thy) looks like a text error for coactos
